en.title: DriftDate — Layered Dating
en.subtitle: Dating that widens slowly
en.short_description: Dating that starts in your ZIP code and widens only when you want it to.
en.description:
Most dating apps open with the whole country and let you filter down. DriftDate does the opposite: it starts where you are and widens only when you ask it to.

—— Layers ——

Discovery expands in steps — ZIP code, then county, then state, then everywhere. You choose when to move outward, so "nearby" actually means nearby, and you see your own area properly before it gets diluted.

—— Safety is part of the product ——

COARSE LOCATION, ALWAYS
Your position is deliberately blurred before it is ever used. Raw coordinates are never exposed to another user, and no one can see exactly where you are.

TRUST PASSPORT AND TRUST SCORE
See what has actually been verified about someone, rather than guessing from photos.

SAFETY CENTRE
Blocking, reporting and safety guidance in one place, not buried in settings.

BLOCK LIST
Block anyone, at any time. Blocks are immediate and permanent unless you undo them.

—— Talking to people ——

CHAT WITH REPLY SUGGESTIONS
When a conversation stalls, DriftDate can suggest a reply, with the tone matched to the thread rather than one generic template.

DATE PLANNER
Work out where to actually go, together.

AI COMPATIBILITY
A read on what you have in common, shown as reasons rather than a bare number.

—— Honest about what this is ——

DriftDate is for adults looking to meet other adults. It is 17+. Meeting someone from the internet carries real risk: tell a friend where you are going, meet in public first, and use the Safety Centre. We verify what we can and cannot vouch for anyone.

en.release_notes:
First release of DriftDate.

• Layered discovery: ZIP, county, state, then everywhere - you choose when to widen
• Location is always coarsened; raw coordinates are never exposed to another user
• Trust Passport and Trust Score show what has actually been verified
• Safety Centre with blocking, reporting and guidance
• Chat with tone-matched reply suggestions
• Date planner and AI compatibility reasons

Feedback is welcome at contact@americangroup.ai.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
Most dating apps open with the whole country and let you filter down. DriftDate does the opposite: it starts where you are and widens only when you ask it to.

Intended audience:
Dating that widens slowly

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
The app opens on a sign-in screen. Test credentials are in the demo account fields of App Review Information.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Supabase — account and data storage
- Google Sign-In — authentication
- Sign in with Apple — authentication
- device location services (on-device)

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app ships 12 languages (Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish). Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
Account deletion is available in the app under Settings, and on the support site.
